text:
Anika M: Hey design — we need an asset pack for next week's Inference Spotlight webinar. Priority: a micro-GIF hero + 3 benchmarking card templates (latency vs cost, throughput vs quality, memory tradeoffs). Deliverables: hero (1200x628 GIF + MP4), cards (800x800 and 1200x628 variants), Figma components, and an assets README with export presets. Need alt text and two color-contrast-safe palettes (brand + high-contrast). Also require short copy variants for A/B (headline, 1-line technical blurb, CTA) and JP/FR/DE localization. Can we get first drafts by Tue EOD? @Sam (Design) @Aya (L10n) @Diego (Growth)

Sam (Design): Yep — can take this. Timeline: first pass by Tue noon PST. Quick Q: do you want an animated sparkline inside the hero or frame-by-frame transitions for the metrics? Animated looks nicer but GIF size jumps. I can deliver both options (GIF optimized + MP4 fallback).

Diego: Let's include a routing manifest with UTM keys so inbound leads map to webinar cohorts. I'll paste the standard mapping and can wire it to the landing page once assets are named.

Aya (L10n): Heads up — I need the final master copy by Mon 6pm PST to localize JP/FR/DE and provide shortened CTAs for JP. If copy changes after that we'll need addl turnaround.

Sam (Design): Understood. I'll produce a Figma file with components, export tokens, and an "exports" page. Accessibility checklist will be included: alt text templates, color contrast ratios, and suggested keyboard-focus fallback for animated elements.

Anika M: Please include a QA checklist covering brand compliance (logo lockups, minimum clearspace, fonts), legal flags, and a short "do not use" swatch list. Also add a suggested copy pairing table for each card variant (headline + 1-line).

LegalBot: Reminder: EU marketing copy should avoid the word "free" unless legal-approved. Send copy to legal@redwood.ai for review before final export.

Sam (Design): Quick mock is in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/micro-gif-hero (placeholder link) — will update with real frames. Export presets I'll include: GIF low/med/high, MP4 H.264 short loop, sprite sheet for web fallback.

Liam (Marketing Ops): For routing: Diego, can you paste the small JSON manifest you mentioned so I can confirm our query params? I'll plug into the page and the webhook that creates webinar cohorts.

Diego: Here's the minimal manifest we'll use (paste):
```json
{"utm_source":"email","utm_medium":"webinar","utm_campaign":"inference-spotlight-mar2026","route":"/webinar/inference-spotlight","cohort":"mar2026_launch"}
```
Use naming pattern on assets so ops can match assets -> cohort (see naming conv below).

Sam (Design): Proposed naming conv for exports: `redwood_bench_{role}_{variant}_v{semver}_{lang}.ext` e.g. `redwood_bench_hero_animated_v1_en.gif` or `redwood_bench_card_latency_v2_fr.png`. I'll add this to the README.

Aya (L10n): FYI — JP headlines should be ~12–18 chars max for mobile. I'll provide suggestions. For FR/DE watch for long nouns; may need condensed layouts.

Sam (Design): Noted — I'll keep text boxes auto-layout-friendly and provide typographic scales. Also creating a grayscale variant for print and a single-color silhouette for partners.

Anika M: Can we also get a microtile template that allows non-design folks to swap numbers (CSV-driven)? That'd help the benchmark dashboard team.

Sam (Design): Yes — I'll add a Figma component with named text layers and an export script note. Will include a simple CSV -> image export example in the README (snippet + recommended node script).

Diego: One more ask: include a small JSON manifest in the asset README mapping filename -> UTM template so landing pages can auto-assign cohort metadata.

Sam (Design): Will do. Quick ETA recap: Tue noon PST — Figma first-pass (mock + components). Wed EOD — localized exports + QA doc + routing manifest. If legal review slips we may push final exports by Thu.

Anika M: Perfect, thanks everyone. Tag me when the Figma is ready. Also cc @DesignOps for file access and storage path. :pray:

DesignOps: File access note — please add `marketing-webinars/2026-03-inference-spotlight` to shared drive once final.

Sam (Design): Adding checklist items to the Figma README now: export sizes, alt text templates, aria-label recommendations, contrast ratios, legal flags, and localization notes. I'll ping when first pass is up. :thumbsup:
